limitations: change-detected snapshots, not a closing series
a snapshot exists only when the catalog fingerprint changed (every 30 min in the Thu-Sun slate window, 6-hourly otherwise); a point is published only when the ticker's quote changed
games are pruned after kickoff, so a ticker's last snapshot may precede kickoff by hours
post-settlement 0/1 sentinel books are published as null quotes
trimmed to each ticker's last 21 quote states to stay under 400000 bytes
